arxiv-1602-01982.title: On the Capacity of the Half-Duplex MIMO Gaussian Diamond Channel
arxiv-1602-01982.creator: Antony V. Mampilly and Srikrishna Bhashyam
arxiv-1602-01982.description: Abstract In this paper, we analyze the 2-relay multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) Gaussian diamond channel. We show that a multihopping decode-and-forward with multiple access (MDF-MAC) protocol achieves rates within a constant gap from capacity when a channel parameter Δ \Delta is greater than zero.

arxiv-2210-06293.title: Two-stream Network for ECG Signal Classification
arxiv-2210-06293.creator: Xinyao Hou, Shengmei Qin, Jianbo Su
arxiv-2210-06293.description: Abstract Electrocardiogram (ECG), a technique for medical monitoring of cardiac activity, is an important method for identifying cardiovascular disease. However, analyzing the increasing quantity of ECG data consumes a lot of medical resources. This paper explores an effective algorithm for automatic classifications of multi-classes of heartbeat types based on ECG.

arxiv-2304-02264.title: Persuading to Prepare for Quitting Smoking with a Virtual Coach: Using States and User Characteristics to Predict Behavior Conference: Proc. of the 22nd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2023); May 29 – June 2, 2023; London, United Kingdom 71
arxiv-2304-02264.creator: Nele Albers, Mark A. Neerincx, Willem-Paul Brinkman
arxiv-2304-02264.description: Abstract . Despite their prevalence in eHealth applications for behavior change, persuasive messages tend to have small effects on behavior. Conditions or states (e.g., confidence, knowledge, motivation) and characteristics (e.g., gender, age, personality) of persuadees are two promising components for more effective algorithms for choosing persuasive messages.

arxiv-2307-04438.title: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Assisted Railway Communications: A survey
arxiv-2307-04438.creator: Aline Habib 1 , Ammar El Falou 2 , Charlotte Langlais 1 , Marion Berbineau 4
arxiv-2307-04438.description: Abstract The number of train passengers and the demand for high data rates to handle new technologies such as video streaming and IoT technologies are continuously increasing. Therefore the exploration of millimeter waves (mmWave) band is a key technology to meet this demand. However, the high penetration loss makes mmWave very sensitive to blocking, limiting its coverage area.

arxiv-2309-03738.title: On the Iwasawa invariants of Artin representations
arxiv-2309-03738.creator: Aditya Karnataki, Anwesh Ray
arxiv-2309-03738.description: Abstract . We study Iwasawa invariants associated to Selmer groups of Artin representations, and criteria for the vanishing of the associated algebraic Iwasawa invariants. The conditions obtained can be used to study natural distribution questions in this context. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 11R23, 11R34, 11F80 (Primary) 1.

arxiv-2402-08928.title: Noise estimation in an entanglement distillation protocol
arxiv-2402-08928.creator: Ananda G. Maity * {}^{\text{*}} Joshua C. A. Casapao Naphan Benchasattabuse, Michal Hajdušek Rodney Van Meter David Elkouss
arxiv-2402-08928.description: Abstract Estimating noise processes is an essential step for practical quantum information processing. Standard estimation tools require consuming valuable quantum resources. Here we ask the question of whether the noise affecting entangled states can be learned solely from the measurement statistics obtained during a distillation protocol.

arxiv-2407-19066.title: Stochastic Gene Expression Model of Nuclear-to-Cell Ratio Homeostasis
arxiv-2407-19066.creator: Xuesong Bai, Thomas G. Fai
arxiv-2407-19066.description: Abstract . Cell size varies between different cell types, and between different growth and osmotic conditions. However, the nuclear-to-cell volume ratio (N/C ratio) remains nearly constant. In this paper, we build on existing deterministic models of N/C ratio homeostasis and develop a simplified protein translation model to study the effect of stochasticity on the N/C ratio homeostasis.

arxiv-2410-10490.title: Charged Lepton Flavour Violating Meson Decays in Seesaw Models
arxiv-2410-10490.creator: Pravesh Chndra Awasthi, Jai More, Akhila Kumar Pradhan, Kumar Rao, Purushottam Sahu, and S. Uma Sankar
arxiv-2410-10490.description: Abstract The occurrence of neutrino oscillations demands the existence of flavour violation in charged lepton sector. The relation between the branching ratios of different charged lepton flavour violating (CLFV) decay modes depends on the details of the neutrino mass model.

arxiv-2505-18589.title: A Sequent Calculus Perspective on Base-Extension Semantics (Technical Report)
arxiv-2505-18589.creator: Victor Barroso-Nascimento, Ekaterina Piotrovskaya, Elaine Pimentel
arxiv-2505-18589.description: Abstract We define base-extension semantics ( 𝖡𝖾𝖲 \sf{BeS} ) using atomic systems based on sequent calculus rather than natural deduction. While traditional 𝖡𝖾𝖲 \sf{BeS} aligns naturally with intuitionistic logic due to its constructive foundations, we show that sequent calculi with multiple conclusions yield a 𝖡𝖾𝖲 \sf{BeS} framework more suited to classical semantics.

arxiv-2506-16816.title: Electromagnetic radiation by turbulent, magnetized and randomly inhomogeneous solar radio sources generated by electron beams
arxiv-2506-16816.creator: C. Krafft, A. S. Volokitin, F. J. Polanco-Rodríguez, P. Savoini
arxiv-2506-16816.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by C. Krafft, A. S. Volokitin, F. J. Polanco-Rodríguez, P. Savoini. During Type III solar radio bursts, electromagnetic waves are radiated at plasma frequency ω p \omega_{p} and its harmonics by electrostatic wave turbulence generated by electron beams ejected by Sun in randomly inhomogeneous solar wind and coronal plasmas. These emissions, detected since decades by spacecraft and radiotelescopes, are split by the plasma magnetic field into three modes 𝒳 \mathcal{X} , 𝒪 \mathcal{O} and 𝒵 \mathcal{Z} of different dispersion, polarization and radiation properties.

arxiv-2601-06417.title: In-ice Radio Signatures of Cosmic Ray Particle Cascades Journal: Astroparticle Physics
arxiv-2601-06417.creator: Simon Chiche, Simona Toscano, Krijn D. de Vries
arxiv-2601-06417.description: Abstract To detect ultra-high-energy neutrinos, experiments such as the Askaryan Radio Array and the Radio Neutrino Observatory in Greenland target the radio emission induced by these particles as they cascade in the ice, using deep in-ice antennas at the South Pole or in Greenland.

arxiv-2604-14020.title: Saturation and isomorphism of abstract harmonic spaces
arxiv-2604-14020.creator: Haoming Wang

openalex-w7213906229.title: A IMPORTÂNCIA DA ABORDAGEM FISIOTERAPÊUTICA INDIVIDUALIZADA NA REABILITAÇÃO E QUALIDADE DE VIDA APÓS O ACIDENTE VASCULAR CEREBRAL
openalex-w7213906229.creator: Ana Luiza Lopes da Costa, Dhebora Alves Nascimento, Meury Kethely Alves Feitosa, Ezaquilane Pereira Gonçalves, Layssa Cristina Gomes dos Santos
openalex-w7213906229.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7213906229.description: O presente estudo teve como objetivo descrever a importância da abordagem fisioterapêutica individualizada na reabilitação e na qualidade de vida de pacientes pós-Acidente Vascular Cerebral. Trata-se de uma revisão integrativa da literatura, conduzida em seis etapas, com busca...

pmc-10523733.title: Association of niacin intake with constipation in adult: result from the National Health and Nutrition Examination
pmc-10523733.creator: Xiao Huang, Liwen Zhao, Zhenyang Li, Xiaodong Gu, Mingzhe Li, Jianbin Xiang
pmc-10523733.description: BackgroundAlthough dietary intake is believed to be associated with constipation, there is currently a lack of research exploring the relationship between niacin intake and constipation. Therefore, the aim of this study is to investigate the association between niacin intake in adults and constipation using data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES).

pmc-11505237.title: Effect of Spicatoside a on Anti-Osteosarcoma MG63 Cells through Reactive Oxygen Species Generation and the Inhibition of the PI3K-AKT-mTOR Pathway
pmc-11505237.creator: Hyung-Mun Yun, Soo Hyun Kim, Yoon-Ju Kwon, Kyung-Ran Park
pmc-11505237.description: Osteosarcoma is a primary malignant tumor found in the bones of children and adolescents. Unfortunately, many patients do not respond well to treatment and succumb to the illness. Therefore, it is necessary to discover novel bioactive compounds to overcome therapeutic limitations. Liriope platyphylla Wang et Tang is a well-known herb used in oriental medicine.

pmc-11638045.title: Case report: A case of giant malignant solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura with Doege-Potter’s syndrome and review of the literature
pmc-11638045.creator: Jie Li, Hong-Tao Tang, Qing Liu, Cai-Han Li, Wei-Yang Chen, Zeng-Wei Yu, Lei Wang, Lin Lin, Jin-Lan Zhao, Chun-Yan Zhao, Long-Qi Chen, Dong Tian
pmc-11638045.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura (SFTP) is a rare intrathoracic neoplasm that commonly originates from the subpleural mesenchymal cells of the visceral pleura and accounts for less than 5% of all pleural tumors. We reported a case of a 54-year-old man with a two-week history of hypoglycemia, a six-month history of productive cough and fatigue, and chronic right chest pain.

pmc-12374629.title: Precision oncology for advanced-stage adenocarcinoma of the appendix: comprehensive molecular characterisation identifies actionable lesions and potential predictive biomarkers
pmc-12374629.creator: Sebastian Lange, Hannah Lisiecki, Simon Kreutzfeldt, Christoph Heining, Lena Weiss, Christoph Benedikt Westphalen, Albrecht Stenzinger, Daniel Hübschmann, Moritz Jesinghaus, Hanno Glimm, Stefan Fröhling, Nicole Pfarr, Anna Melissa Schlitter
pmc-12374629.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveAppendiceal adenocarcinoma is a rare cancer with very limited therapeutic options. We aimed to determine whether molecular profiling of advanced appendiceal adenocancer can identify actionable therapeutic alterations.MethodsWe retrospectively analysed cohorts from two large German precision oncology programmes. Patient records and pathology reports from 19 patients with advanced appendiceal adenocarcinoma who were enrolled between 2015 and 2021 were included in this study.

pmc-12564662.title: Designing and Implementing a Metaverse Strategy for Fall Prevention in Older Adults: A Theoretical Review
pmc-12564662.creator: Hongje Jang, Sangcheol Bae, John Yoo, Jongsuk Lee, Soonjang Kwon, Eunju Jung, JongEun Yim, Silvia Giovannini, Yuji Uchio
pmc-12564662.description: The aim of this study was to propose the use of metaverse technology as an effective educational method for fall prevention in older adults. A theoretical review was conducted by analyzing publications from PubMed/MEDLINE, EBSCO, SciELO, and Google Scholar using the search terms “metaverse,” “falls,” “older adults,” “virtual reality,” and “exercise.

pmc-12976687.title: Construction of a Bioactive ECM Interface Enables Concurrent Suppression of Foreign Body Reaction, Inflammation, and Promotion of Urethral Regeneration
pmc-12976687.creator: Peihong Han, Xinyu Lei, Shutong Li, Kai Fu, Xiuhong Sun, Rui Zhou, Yuqing Niu
pmc-12976687.description: The development of tissue-engineered urethral grafts (TEUGs) remains challenged by significant hurdles, particularly in overcoming intraurethral stricture. A core issue is the foreign body reaction (FBR) induced by the implant, which impairs the integration of TEUGs with the autologous urethra.

pmc-13154912.title: Tunable Structural Color in Copolymer Microgels Through Controlled Synthesis and Thermally Induced Assembly
pmc-13154912.creator: Manuel Kraus, Mirela Malekovic, Ionel Adrian Dinu, Cornelia G. Palivan
pmc-13154912.description: Structural color formation in soft colloidal systems represents a promising approach toward stimuli‐responsive photonic materials. In this study, the assembly of poly(N‐isopropylacrylamide) (PNIPAm)‐based microgels incorporating varying percentages of anionic (methacrylic acid), neutral (acrylamide), and cationic (2‐(dimethylamino)ethyl methacrylate) comonomers to create multifunctional colloidal building blocks capable of forming dynamic structural colors was systematically investigated.

pmc-13271743.title: Genome reorganization and its functional impact during breast cancer progression
pmc-13271743.creator: Kathleen S Metz Reed, Andrew Fritz, Haley Greenyer, Kerstin Heselmeyer-Haddad, Seth Frietze, Janet Stein, Gary Stein, Tom Misteli, Yu Zhao, Caigang Liu, Yu Zhao, Anonymous, Anonymous, Anonymous, Kathleen S Metz Reed, Andrew Fritz, Haley Greenyer, Kerstin Heselmeyer-Haddad, Seth Frietze, Janet Stein, Gary Stein, Tom Misteli

pmc-13344410.title: How do women respond to increased care needs of their parents? The economic costs of informal caregiving☆
pmc-13344410.creator: Jacek Barszczewski, Ricarda Milstein, Jinkook Lee, Ana Llena-Nozal
pmc-13344410.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). When a person becomes care-dependent, family members often provide informal care. This paper examines the economic impact of informal caregiving, with a particular focus on women who care for their ageing parents. Using data from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), covering 24 countries, we estimate the effect of caregiving on labour supply and quantify its associated costs in terms of Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

pmc-13358587.title: Energy availability as an integrative framework: reinterpreting the energy balance and carbohydrate–insulin models in athletes
pmc-13358587.creator: Nana Chung
pmc-13358587.description: [Purpose]This review reinterprets the Energy Balance Model (EBM) and the Carbohydrate–Insulin Model (CIM) within athletic contexts and evaluates their explanatory relevance for low energy availability (LEA) and relative energy deficiency in sport (RED-S).[Methods]We conducted a structured conceptual review using a narrative synthesis approach.

pmc-13474355.title: The 4th National Neurology Forum | Interview with Prof. Paul Verschure
pmc-13474355.creator: Stefana-Andrada Dobran, Alexandra Gherman
pmc-13474355.description: tarted my career as a psychologist, then moved to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics, and from there I transitioned to neuroscience. Now I am bringing all these fields together. What brings me here is that, for the last twenty years, I have been on a mission to bring brain theory to the clinic.

pmc-13536295.title: The influence of initial incisal overlap on mandibular plane rotation, 3D airway dimensions, and hyoid bone changes following surgery-first mandibular setback in skeletal Class III patients: A pilot study
pmc-13536295.creator: Varumporn Rotchanakitamnuai, Pornkawee Charoenlarp, Preeya Suwanwitid
pmc-13536295.description: Background/purposeSkeletal Class III malocclusion often requires mandibular setback, which can affect airway patency and skeletal stability, particularly when managed with a surgery-first orthognathic approach (SFOA). This study evaluated the influence of initial incisal overlap on mandibular plane (MP) rotation, pharyngeal airway volume, and hyoid bone position following surgery-first isolated mandibular setback in skeletal Class III patients.
